notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.1.5 | The optimization update
notes.content:
Hello everybody, in this update we decided to focus on optimization and bug fixes. Here's what's included in the update:
[list][*]Major optimizations. (in the editor with another game window open while profiling, our FPS jumped from 58fps on average to 120fps)
[*]Disable powerup respawns as they were broken, and helped optimize the game even further.
[*]Fixed issue where the map is entirely filled with powerups.
[*]Disabled glossiness and reflections of grass and wood.
[*]Lessening of mouse smoothing.
[*]Add new metal crate model and texture.
[*]Certain bomb issues were fixed.
[*]Certain desynchronization issues were fixed.
[*]A lot of null checks, which should lessen or eliminate bugs in general.
[*]Added new people to the list of collaborators.[/list]

Consider supporting us by buying the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933400/Multibombers__Supporter_Pack/]supporter pack[/url] or on [url=https://patreon.com/GlorifiedPig]Patreon[/url]. It will greatly help speed development, and updates will come quicker with more content inside. Plus, you get cool perks!

Please restart your game to see the update. If it is still not visible, please restart your Steam.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.1.4 | Halloween update!
notes.content:
Hey everybody, today we've decided to release our Halloween update! Here's what's included:
[list][*]Completely got rid of bomb collisions for now, which is a definite fix to the bombs killing players through walls.
[*]Added a new pumpkin bomb, which glows the players colour from the inside.
[*]Added a few new spooky, hellish skyboxes.
[*]Updated the credits.
[*]Enable the default unity resolution dialog, so players can change the input keys (which allows our AZERTY players to play easier!) and to easily change the quality level.
[*]Updated our skybox system.
[*]Anti-cheat updates.
[*]Small bug fixes.
[*]Reset statistics for this update.[/list]

Please restart your game to see the update. If it is still not visible, please restart your Steam.

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.1.1
notes.content:
Hey all, here's the fourth patch for Multibombers, which adds a very requested feature, bomb collisions! Here's what's all included:

[list][*]Bomb collisions - everybody will have collisions with the bomb except the person who'd placed the bomb.
[*]Anticheat updates in an attempt to stop more cheaters.
[*]Disabled IL2CPP as it causes crashing, we will update the DLLs and include this in the next version.[/list]

Please restart your game to see the update. If it is still not visible, please restart your Steam.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.1.0
notes.content:
Hey everybody, today we have the first "minor" update. If you don't know already, we follow the versioning system MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH - here's what's included in this update:
[list][*]Basic start to an anti-cheat.
[*]Fixed player GameObject not loading in correctly.
[*]Implement anti-variable manipulation to prevent cheating powerups & tags.
[*]Added AJ Mould to the credits. Thanks for supporting!
[*]Added a report button to the lobby.
[*]Localization additions.
[*]Made a menu for joining the Discord on startup & implemented an achievement for it.
[*]Some default settings changed; background music is now default to be enabled in game and the default quality is now medium.
[*]Disabled some settings that weren't used and will be implemented in the future.
[*]Fixed tags not re-assigning after the lobby restarts after you finish a game.
[*]Add a supporter popup after 30 minutes playtime (don't worry, once you select yes or no, you'll never see the panel ever again)
[*]The bomb colour is now the same as the player colour.
[*]Created our own system for determining play time.[/list]

Please restart your game to see the update. If it is still not visible, please restart your Steam.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everybody, here's the second update of the day, which features some minor additions and small bug fixes to make the game feel better to play. Here's whats included:

[list][*]Add version display in the bottom left.
[*]Added new skybox pack and changed main menu skybox.
[*]Potential fix for spectator bug (let us know!)
[*]Fixed bug where the cursor wouldn't show in the escape menu.
[*]There's now an announcement when a player joins the lobby.
[*]New green collaborator tags.
[*]Added "LSRQ" to supporter list in credits, thanks!
[*]New sponsor with link in main menu.
[*]Randomization of skyboxes on game start - there is currently two but more are planned in the future.
[*]Disable private matchmaking section & give small notice in the bottom left.
[*]Full lobby achievement is now more accurate.[/list]

Please restart your game to see the update. If it is still not visible, please restart your Steam.

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everybody, as you all know we have been extremely busy because of the game's release approximately 4 hours ago, on the 23rd of September 2018, 2:30 AM (GMT+2). Many bug reports came through and we have been working very hard to fix all the bug reports were reported. Here's a list of what's changed:

[list][*]Servers should now be visible regardless of region, meaning you can play with your friends around the world.
[*]Fixed the "Connecting..." menu not going away even after a connection failure.
[*]Fixed the return button not working when hosting after a game.
[*]Made it so that when you host after a game, it's no longer private so new people can join.
[*]Two new people added to the credits, thanks Jarrod Corbett and "King_Wailord" for supporting![/list]

Please restart your game to see the update. If it is still not visible, please restart your Steam.
